config.target_name: Zipline-adjusted close return proxy, rank-normalized within observed training cohorts
config.universe_name: Past-price/liquidity-selected US equity securities, including non-common-stock instruments
config.primary_metric: Equal-weighted daily observed-case Spearman IC in 2009-2010 development predictions
config.primary_comparison: Fixed hgb_7 minus fixed ridge_100, not a best-of-grid comparison
config.model_selection: Development-only candidate ranking; not a confirmatory result or automatic holdout release
config.missing_outcome_policy: Predict all eligible rows; retain missing labels and report coverage plus Kendall tau-a completion bounds
config.label_boundaries: No label may use any price or adjustment on/after 2011-01-01; last six development sessions remain forecasted but boundary-censored
data_scope_limitations: Historical common-stock/security-type and exchange membership are not qualified; snapshot classifications are not eligibility inputs
Vendor adjustment ratios define a price-return proxy, not fully qualified cash-distribution total return
Missing terminal payouts and merger consideration remain unresolved; missing labels are not assumed zero
Source revision/publication timestamps are not qualified
The 2011 data received coverage auditing but no prediction-performance evaluation; it is not described as never accessed
config.data_export_policy: Raw bars, feature cache, per-security targets and forecasts remain inside QuantRocket; only code and aggregate analytical results may be shared

prediction_scope: All decision-eligible test rows, including missing future labels
